subject: Compliance add-ons: amortized fee vs. up-front seat charge (Northridge Health)
messages:

Cc: Jorge Rivera <jorge.rivera@northridgehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@northridgehealth.com>

Subject: Initial questions on compliance add-ons and billing profile

Thanks Ben — quick follow up from our demo. Two questions for your team before procurement will circulate an internal SOW: 1) For audit logs and KMS seats, do you prefer to price as an annual flat fee or as a per-seat monthly charge? 2) If we sign a 24-month commit, can ancillary compliance fees be amortized into the committed discount rather than billed separately? Procurement wants the cost to appear as a single committed line item.

Also, J. from Security asked about data residency — are EU and APAC hosting packaged the same way or treated as add-ons with separate credits?

Appreciate a quick note on options so I can move this to our finance team.

— Marta
Procurement Manager
Northridge Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@northridgehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial questions on compliance add-ons and billing profile

Hi Marta — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Short answers up front, followed by options: 

1) Pricing shape: We can do either annual flat fees or monthly per-seat billing. For audit logs and KMS/HSM we commonly offer: 
   • Annual seat charge (preferred for enterprise accounting) 
   • Or per-seat monthly (easier for variable headcount)

2) Amortization into commit: Yes — for deals with a minimum 12–24 month committed ARR we frequently fold compliance add-ons into the committed discount line so it shows as a single committed monthly equivalent on your invoice. That requires: 
   • Commit term on the core service (e.g., 24 months) 
   • An agreed amortization schedule (we normally amortize over the commit period)

3) Residency: EU is handled as a regional residency SKU (treated as a residency add-on). APAC is the same but we price APAC regions separately for cloud egress and capacity. We can provide a blended residency credit if you want a single line item.

I'll loop in Monica and Markus to propose two concrete pricing options (amortized vs. stand-alone) with a worked example. Attaching a workbook with preliminary math.

Thanks — Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: compliance-addon-pricing-workback.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Proposed option A — Amortized compliance (24-month commit)

Marta / Jorge — attaching a cleaned SOW draft and a pricing sheet. Option A (amortized):

Summary:
• 24-month core commit: $360k committed ARR ($15k/mo core)
• Compliance add-ons: Audit logs ($48k one-time), KMS/HSM seat premium ($24k one-time)
• Amortization: add-ons amortized equally over 24 months => $3k/mo added to the committed line (total shown as $18k/mo on invoice)
• Discount: We apply an additional 5% commit discount on token usage because compliance add-ons are amortized into the commit (visible in hubspot as single committed line)

Pros: single-line accounting for finance; simpler renewal math; predictable unit economics.
Cons: if you materially reduce usage mid-term, we keep the amortization schedule (standard credit terms apply).

Attached: RDW-3492_SOW-draft.pdf; compliance-addon-pricing-workback.xlsx

Would you like a version that amortizes only audit logs but not HSM seats? We can run that too.

- Monica
